notes: Two-directional walker candidate output. masked_cells: pooled=HRRR × regime says NBM helps (halves both >0). masked_cells_hrrr: pooled=NBM × regime says HRRR helps (halves both <0). Both use n >= min_n_regime and |lift| >= min_lift_pct_regime. Downstream walker gates each direction independently, then l1_selector routes the cleared cells with precedence over the pooled band pick.
